sourceText:
Best Honey Barbecue Ribs
By: Santa's Gift Sh...
Published: Friday, February 19, 2010 - 9:02pm

Ingredients




3 pounds of Country Style pork or beef ribs (I used boneless)
1 teaspoon minced garlic
garlic powder
salt
pepper
BBQ Sauce
2 cups Honey BBQ sauce
1 1/2 cups Brown sugar
2 teaspoons Dijon mustard

Preparation

1 Line a 9 x 13" pan with aluminum foil overlapping the sides enough to fold over top of ribs. 2 Place Country Style ribs in pan and sprinkle both sides with garlic powder, salt,  pepper and minced garlic 3 Fold aluminum foil over and place in pre-heated 250F. oven and bake for 2 hrs. 4 While ribs are baking, mix together Brown sugar, Honey BBQ sauce, and Dijon mustard into a beautiful basting glaze. 5 After baking for 2 hrs. take ribs out of oven, drain excess water and grease from pan, and baste ribs with glaze. 
 6 Brush glaze all over each rib on both sides and put back into oven for 1 hr...Take out..Optional: baste 1 more time for an even thicker glaze and put back in the oven for 10 more min. 7 Throw out any un-used sauce since you have been using a brush back and forth to raw meat..so for health reasons you would not use any left over sauce.

About


Oh my Goodness........These ribs are the
Best I've tasted in a long time!!!! My husband
said "Honey, these are the Best Ribs you've ever
made..ever"....3 times...in 1 minute!!!! The
rest of the family said the same thing!!! I 'll have
to make these more often if I can receive that kind
of appreciation....
I've made Country Style Boneless Ribs for a lot
of years but these are different...I experimented with
the recipe & found some Great flavors (the Dijon
mustard gives it a KICK) to blend in the sauce & a
different way to bake them!! Soooooooo..of course I
wanted to share these ideas with you guys....
After you make these..you'll have to keep them
hidden or they'll be gone...Before dinner! That's
what my family told me..so be forewarned..
These would be a SUPER football party food.
The glaze could be even put over wings or chicken
legs. Deliciousssssssssssssssss.....Enjoy..

Comments:
Doug

Barbecued ribs are my favorite food.  These ribs are to die for!  The homemade sauce is as good as it gets; it is just wonderful.
A.

Amazing!  Mouthwatering!  Restaurant-quality!  These are fabulous - everyone must try them!
